lines: In this repeating world, how many times must I reach out my hand
before these fleeting tears melt this blackened heart?
If the feelings that have begun to sprout echo in my chest,
I'll keep protecting you, beside you, unchanged, always
If I pick up the fallen hope and link it to tomorrow,
even these tangled, twisted wishes will come undone
I held up the light and erased my hesitation
what I wanted to give you was the future
Still holding the nights I've wept through, I cry out my grief
the ideals far away gently heal
the feet that stepped forward
Gripping our sure bond tightly, let's go on, anywhere at all
with a miracle stained through and through at my back
If I touch these manufactured feelings, more than anything
they're warm, and reality begins to blur
Even if I keep questioning this world gone mad,
did you already know no answer would ever come?
The wish blurred by tears will never waver
it only quietly gives me pain without end
I came to know sorrow, and came to know joy
Weakness changed you,
you stopped, time peeled away, and you broke everything
entrusting words that could never reach
what do the eyes that see
feel, that you push it all away?
As if to hide your heart
The meaning of being here now—
if you would tell me,
I can stay strong, always, unchanged
I held up the light and erased my hesitation
what I wanted to give you was the future
Still holding the nights I've wept through, I cry out my grief
the ideals far away gently heal
the feet that stepped forward
Grip this certain bond tightly and let's go on, anywhere at all
Doubt? Open your eyes,
shake it off and reach out your hand
with a miracle stained through and through at my back
